environment_baseline.affinity_policy: observe and require exactly 0-31; never silently narrow or widen
environment_baseline.history_affinity_note: Some legacy experiments used 0-7; they are separate historical references.

formal_modes: Unified driver B/parallel and C/serial only; A1 is an adaptation reference.
adaptation_regression: A1/B must agree on actual schedules, yield matrices and validated error outcomes. Any discrepancy is preserved for review and blocks that program's formal phase; no repeated attempts are selected to obtain agreement. Legacy reorder_10 error-count variation is a known reference observation, not a waiver for the corrected cohort.
independent_round: New driver process and work/output directory for every round; no parallel runs in the shared IPC namespace.
artifact_policy: Reuse existing binaries. Missing or unverified artifacts block that benchmark. Any necessary build requires a separate isolated directory with unchanged pinned source, complete commands/toolchain/exit codes and artifact hashes; never replace historical products.
runtime_kps_policy: Read actual ThreadNum, MaxKpNum and kpNumArray from each invocation; bind them to the verified benchmark identity and require consistency across paired adaptation and formal rounds. No copied reorder_3 KPS.
error_rule: A benchmark assertion failure with a preserved error schedule and matching actual yield record is a bug-triggering schedule. Target aborts are distinct from driver failures; timeouts are never bugs.
budget_boundary: At most 10000 successfully launched logical exploration schedules; valid exhaustion requires executed=completed=10000, in_flight=0, no target timeout, coherent trace and saved records. A generated but unexecuted candidate is not counted as executed.
unsupported_runtime_change: Unexpected dynamic KPS change, retest, malformed prefix or unreconciled physical launch count is preserved as an invalid/manual-review round for this fixed CS.reorder protocol; it is not silently discarded or retried.
first_bug_policy: Use the first actual failing logical schedule ordinal, or null when not detected. Valid nondetection is reported with the actual observation limit and censoring reason; never encode nondetection as 10000.

statistics.standard_deviation: Sample standard deviation, denominator n-1; undefined for n<2.
statistics.first_bug_mean: Conditional mean and sample SD among detected valid rounds only, alongside detection fraction and all censored observations.
statistics.bug_detection_rate: Valid rounds detecting the assertion / all valid rounds; also report planned, attempted, valid and invalid counts.
statistics.time_measurements: Preserve driver footer time and external wall time separately. Trace/profiling overhead and hardware/affinity differences prevent direct timing comparison with the paper or historical runs.
statistics.data_isolation: Never pool historical A0, the verified pilot, A1 reference runs or adaptation runs with new unified-driver formal rounds.

timeout_rationale.interpretation: A rough extrapolation already exceeds 600 seconds; larger thread counts, generation and profiling overhead may add cost. Freeze a uniform 3600-second round limit before formal execution. This is a conservative policy, not a guaranteed runtime bound.
timeout_rationale.on_round_timeout: Preserve the incomplete attempt as ROUND_TIMEOUT and stop the phase. Do not extend the limit or rerun selectively after viewing results; a changed protocol requires a separately identified cohort.

paper_reference: https://wcventure.github.io/pdf/ICSE2022_PERIOD.pdf, Table 2 and section 4.1.3; paper values are comparison references, never acceptance targets.
authorization: This file prepares the study. Running phases is explicit; no automatic Commit, Push or expansion to other benchmarks.
